exposure: surgical approach (incising uterus at the fundus vs. opening the lower uterine segment)
Group A: incising the uterus at the level of the fundus to avoid disrupting the placenta
Group B: opening the lower uterine segment and delivering the baby through the placenta after the incision
cohort: 26 women with placenta previa who delivered at Al-Karak governmental hospital between January 2019 and January 2022
finding: Incising the upper uterine segment to avoid the placenta (Group A) resulted in significantly less blood loss and shorter hospital stay compared to opening the lower uterine segment and delivering through the placenta (Group B).
